_comment: Wire contract between the Codex shell wrapper (Swift, ShellLaunchConfigurator)
Codex cannot send custom request headers, so its project is carried inside the
request path instead: the wrapper prepends `prefix` + base64url(projectPath) to
the proxy base URL, and the proxy strips that segment back off before provider
Both sides' tests read THIS file rather than restating the encoding, because the
two halves are individually testable and only wrong when paired -- a green Swift
suite and a green Go suite are not evidence that they agree. `healthCapability`
is what the proxy advertises on /health so the app can detect a stale bundled
binary at startup instead of discovering it as a provider 404.
